content.text: /ext:medcp Select a standard therapy for phenylketonuria and report how many patients here received it.
I'll look at the clinical database for phenylketonuria (PKU) treatment. A standard therapy is sapropterin (Kuvan), a BH4 cofactor. Let me first see the available tables, then query.
This is an OMOP CDM database. I'll find the concept for sapropterin (the standard PKU therapy) and count distinct patients with a drug exposure to it.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%sapropterin%'
ORDER BY concept_name
LIMIT 50;

The ingredient concept is `sapropterin` (concept_id 19021959). I'll count distinct patients whose drug exposures map to that ingredient, using the concept_ancestor hierarchy to capture all sapropterin products.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS n_patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 19021959;
